release_notes:
Vortex PT 1.1.0 Public Version:
• RAM Concept mesh element geometry: beams framing into columns extend to the middle of the column in cross-sections.
• Support profile fidelity: high points at column supports accurately reference beam soffit datums, eliminating out-of-slab points.
• Stepped support shaft rendering: column support shafts step seamlessly with the concrete soffit.
• Seamless collinear beams across column supports.
• Reverse parabolic fidelity: elimination of profile kinks/hills across drop-to-beam transitions.
• Shop drawing deduction consistency: plan and cross-section control points display deducted values.
• ADAPT Excel and RTF report elongation import workflow.
• Enhanced license manager and generator startup reliability.
